title: Native Principal Cone Criterion
statement: For a site of object size c and arrow size v, a commutative ring sheaf of size q=max(c,v,r), and the displayed global and slice sheafification, derived-category and countable-product hypotheses on the site and its AsSmall model, the principal cone completion of any scalar chain endomorphism μ is principally locally complete. Q(P) is principally locally complete if and only if the specified principal cone unit is invertible. No site-universe identification, regularity, K-flatness or boundedness is used. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-slices], [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-localization], [def-pur-ringed-principal-local-tests], [def-pur-principal-cone-tower].

source.place: Tags 0999, 099B and 0A0E; sites.tex Tags 03A0 and 03CH for equivalent sites and slices; sites-modules.tex Tags 03DA and 03DG for abelian module categories and intrinsic properties; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 08J7, 0A95 and 0941 for Hom and strict Roos comparisons. See the declaration docstrings for the particular step.

proof.text: The principal cone completion satisfies the local criterion before shrinking the site. Restrict the complex and scalar to AsSmall and apply the small-site criterion. The additive-equivalence comparison identifies its cone completion and its specified unit with the restriction of the native ones. Transfer local completeness by the small-model equivalence. For the unit criterion use the derived comparison square, cancel its two isomorphisms, and reflect invertibility through the derived equivalence. Source: Stacks 03A0, 03CH, 03DA, 03DG, 0999, 099B, 0A0E and 0941.

lean.statement:
theorem nativePrincipalConeCriterion
    (a : (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (P : CochainComplex (NativeModules.{max c v r, c, v} R) ℤ) (μ : End P)
    (hμ : ∀ (q : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X q).val.obj U),
      (μ.f q).val.app U x = @SMul.smul _ _ ((P.X q).val.obj U).isModule.toSMul (a.val U) x) :
    principalLocallyComplete.{c, v, r, w} R a
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.completion μ)) ∧
      (principalLocallyComplete.{c, v, r, w} R a (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ↔
        IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.unit μ)))
